verdict.rationale: Blocking resources is a fair question for a hosted headless-browser platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no Browserbase setting or session option that blocks images or CSS by default. The only related item is a generic mention of "network interception" (browserbase-docs-4). That is a developer building block a user could script, not the product's own default resource-blocking capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
